title: Reinstating a Lapsed Comfort Club Agreement
content:
**Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements — reinstatement.**

## What reinstatement does
A lapsed agreement is reinstated within its renewal grace period at the member's request. Reinstatement returns the agreement to active status, starts the new term on the day after the lapsed term ended and ends it one day before the same calendar date twelve months later, raises the consecutive term count by one, and grants the new term the same maintenance visits and covered-repair benefit that the lapsed term was granted at its start and for systems added during it, as a renewal would.

Reinstatement leaves the locked rate on file and posts no renewal dues of its own; the locked rate and the dues of the reinstated term are decided by the policies that settle them.

Any reinstatement fee is posted to the dues balance with the reinstatement, as a reinstatement fee charge billed to the current month; a fee of 0.00 posts no charge.

### Term dates (hypothetical)
| Lapsed term | Reinstated term | Consecutive term count |
|---|---|---|
| 1 June 2024 to 31 May 2025 | 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026 | 6 at lapse, 7 once reinstated |

The member then sees the agreement active again, with its new term dates and visits available.

## System entry: `reinstate_lapsed_agreement_6e8e1b28`
Reinstatement is an agent-side action: the agent unlocks `reinstate_lapsed_agreement_6e8e1b28` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | Reference number of the member's lapsed Comfort Club agreement, read from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `reinstatement_fee` | Reinstatement fee charged | USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 or positive, rounded to the cent by the caller |

### Return
On success the receipt carries `agreement_id`; `term_start` and `term_end` (YYYY-MM-DD, the new term); `consecutive_terms` (the new count, an integer); `visits_remaining` (visits granted for the new term, an integer); `repair_coverage_remaining` (USD, 2 decimal places, covered-repair benefit granted for the new term); `fee_entry_id` (reference number of the reinstatement fee charge, empty when the fee is 0.00); `reinstatement_fee` (USD, 2 decimal places); `dues_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, signed); and `status`, always "active".

### Basis questions
**Does reinstatement bill the new term's dues?** No. It posts no renewal dues of its own and leaves the locked rate on file as it stands.

**Are the new term's visits the tier's standard grant?** They are the same visits and covered-repair benefit the lapsed term was granted at its start and for systems added during it.
